import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the Titanic dataset
titanic_data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot showing survival rate by passenger class and gender
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plot = sns.catplot(
    data=titanic_data, 
    x="pclass", 
    hue="sex", 
    col="survived",
    kind="count",
    height=5, 
    aspect=1, 
    palette="pastel"
)

plot.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Count")
plot.set_titles("Survival: {col_name}")
plot.set_xticklabels(["1st Class", "2nd Class", "3rd Class"])
plot.add_legend(title="Gender")

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
